item.title: Overview of Zephaniah - The Purifying Fire and the Restoring Song 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # Imagine a city where the sirens have been silent for years. People walk the streets assuming everything is fine, the buildings look stable, the lights stay on, and life feels normal. But beneath the surface, the foundations have been quietly eroding. Engineers have warned for years that the cracks are widening, but no one wants to hear it. “Don’t be dramatic,” they say. “Things look fine.”
